next.reason: 1985: no group VALUE when subordinates have 'JUSTIFIED, SYNCHRONIZED or USAGE (other than USAGE IS DISPLAY)'. §2023:13.18.63.3 SR14: subordinates 'shall not be described with a JUSTIFIED or SYNCHRONIZED clause, and all data items subordinate to an alphanumeric group item shall be ... usage DISPLAY'; SR16 extends it to the table format. Every group a 1985 program can declare is alphanumeric; national and bit groups need GROUP-USAGE and categories absent from 1985, so the narrowing to alphanumeric groups changes no program this rule governs.
